offline_check_against_natural_sciences_c.match_rule: a shared word of at least four characters that appears in fewer than five Danish organisation names in the corpus
offline_check_against_natural_sciences_c.distinctive_word_threshold: appears in fewer than 5 of 762 organisation names
offline_check_against_natural_sciences_c.caveat: matched on name tokens, so each finding should be read before it is believed. A miss is not evidence of no contact.

what_this_is: an attempt to disprove the not-yet-connected claims in data/actions.json using a source CORDIS cannot see
method: sample for-profit Danish organisations that the ranked list says share no Horizon Europe project with AU on that topic, resolve each to an OpenAlex institution by name, and count works co-authored by that institution and Aarhus University I204337017
name_matching_caveat: a name match is used here and nowhere else. It is sound in one direction only: a hit disproves the claim under test, a miss proves nothing because the name may simply not have resolved. Matched names are listed so a bad match can be spotted and discarded.
